pieces.note: into the lounge (green sofas, billiard table); Qin: 'please sit' (muted); she stays standing, he sits

the lounge talk: 'the file was stolen, why not chase them?' 'nothing important is kept here' 'how cunning'; 'why are YOU here?' - the contract, the money, 'I can make you city master'; 'show me your sincerity' 'the formula again?'; 'wait - I know what you want'; 'tonight at ten, the dance hall; everything's ready but the east wind' 'I'll bring you the east wind'
the lounge from the doorway; the post office at night

her thought behind the pillar (quests are scripted; last time I got the formula right here; so all I need to...); the postman on his bicycle: 'stop!' 'what are you doing?' - gun out: 'I'm robbing you of a letter!'
the dance hall, dark red carpet, dancers (a background 'come on' muted)
'Governor Qin, will you dance with me?' - a hand on a shoulder: 'Sorry'
the dance floor from above; Qin sits down across from her at a small table with a paper cone of snacks and the envelope; they eat and wait

'looks like I brought the wrong sincerity' 'Miss Anna'; the envelope: the munitions formula, taken before Sun Jiaying got it; 'satisfied?'; 'we agreed: sincerity for a signed contract'; 'Qin doesn't haggle'; 'then I'm sorry'
the silence: she looks down, Qin in profile, dancers through the curtain
'Governor, then I'll be going.' She rises; soldiers march in and salute; 'Take her away.' (cliffhanger; ep10 opens on 'Qin Xiaoyi, you went back on your word')
